stem: Two long current carrying conductors are placed parallel to each other at a distance of 8 cm between them. The magnitude of magnetic field produced at mid-point between the two conductors due to current flowing in them is $300\ \mu$T. The equal current flowing in the two conductors is:
solution: Fields add only for opposite currents. $B = 2\dfrac{\mu_0I}{2\pi r} = \dfrac{2\times4\pi\times10^{-7}I}{2\pi\times4\times10^{-2}} = 3\times10^{-4}$ T $\Rightarrow I = 30$ A in opposite directions.
